stories.title: The Wise Men Follow the Star

pages.text: Far away in the East, wise men called Magi saw a bright new star. They knew it meant a great King had been born, so they followed it.
The Magi traveled to Jerusalem and asked King Herod, "Where is the newborn King?" Herod's priests said, "In Bethlehem, as the prophets told us."
The star stopped over the house where Jesus was. The Magi knelt down and gave Him gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.
God warned the Magi in a dream not to go back to Herod, so they went home another way. Jesus is the King for everyone, near and far.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: The Magi traveled far to honor Jesus. We celebrate this on Epiphany. Jesus came for everyone.

pages.text: An angel came to Joseph in a dream and said, "Get up! Take Mary and Jesus to Egypt. King Herod wants to harm Him."
That night, Joseph, Mary and baby Jesus left in secret. They traveled far across the desert, and God kept them safe.
When it was safe, an angel told Joseph to take his family home. They settled in Nazareth, where Jesus grew up.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Joseph listened to God and protected his family. God watches over families.

pages.text: John the Baptist lived in the desert. He told people, "Get ready! Be sorry for your sins and turn back to God." Many people came to the Jordan River to be baptized.
One day Jesus came to John at the river. John said, "You should baptize me!" But Jesus said, "This is what God wants." So John baptized Jesus.
As Jesus came out of the water, the sky opened. The Holy Spirit came down like a dove, and a voice from heaven said, "This is my beloved Son."
At Jesus' baptism, we meet God the Father, God the Son and God the Holy Spirit. This is the Trinity. When we are baptized, we are welcomed into God's family.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: God is the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit. They were all at Jesus' baptism.

pages.text: After His baptism, Jesus went into the desert to pray and fast for forty days. He was very hungry.
The devil tempted Jesus: "Turn these stones into bread!" Jesus said, "People need God's words, not only bread." The devil tried two more times, but Jesus said no each time.
At last the devil left. Angels came and took care of Jesus. Jesus always chose to listen to His Father.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus said no to the devil. When we are tempted, we can ask God for help and choose what is good.

pages.text: One day, a great crowd followed Jesus up a hillside. Jesus sat down, and His friends came close to hear Him teach.
Jesus said, "Blessed are the poor in spirit, the gentle, the merciful, and those who make peace. God will bless them." These are called the Beatitudes.
Jesus said, "You are the light of the world. Let your light shine, so that others will see your good deeds and praise your Father in heaven."
Jesus said, "Love your enemies and pray for those who hurt you. Treat others the way you want to be treated."

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus teaches us how to live as God's children: be merciful, be peacemakers, and love everyone.

pages.text: After feeding the crowd, Jesus went up a mountain to pray. His friends crossed the lake in a boat. A strong wind blew, and the waves tossed the boat.
In the dark, the friends saw someone walking on the water! They were scared. Jesus said, "Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid." Peter said, "Lord, let me come to you!"
Peter stepped out, but he saw the big waves and began to sink. "Lord, save me!" Jesus caught his hand. "Why did you doubt?" Then the wind stopped.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: When we are afraid, we can call out to Jesus, and He is right there to help us.

pages.text: Jesus asked His friends, "Who do people say that I am?" Then He asked, "But who do you say that I am?"
Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God!" Jesus said, "Blessed are you, Simon Peter. My Father showed you this."
Jesus said, "You are Peter, the rock. On this rock I will build my Church." He gave Peter the keys to the kingdom of heaven. The Pope follows Peter today.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus built His Church on Peter. The Pope leads the Church today, and we pray for him.

pages.text: Jesus took Peter, James and John up a high mountain to pray. While they watched, Jesus' face shone like the sun, and His clothes became bright white.
Two great prophets, Moses and Elijah, appeared and talked with Jesus. A bright cloud covered them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my beloved Son. Listen to Him!"
The friends fell down, afraid. Jesus touched them and said, "Get up. Do not be afraid." Jesus is God's Son, and we should listen to Him.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: The Father said to listen to His Son. We listen to Jesus when we read the Gospel and pray.

pages.text: Jesus told a story. A shepherd had one hundred sheep. One day, one little sheep wandered away and was lost.
The shepherd left the ninety-nine safe and went looking for the lost sheep. He searched over the hills and through the valleys until he found it.
He lifted the sheep onto his shoulders and carried it home, full of joy. Jesus said, "God loves every one of us, and He is happy when we come home to Him."

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus is the Good Shepherd. He knows each of us by name and never stops looking for us.

pages.text: Parents brought their little children to Jesus so He could bless them. But the apostles said, "Do not bother Jesus!"
Jesus said, "Let the children come to me. Do not stop them!" He gathered them in His arms, put His hands on them and blessed them.
Jesus said, "The kingdom of heaven belongs to people who are like these children." Jesus loves you very much, too.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus loves every child. God made each of us in His image, and we are precious to Him.

pages.text: Jesus and His friends came near Jerusalem. Jesus sent two friends to bring a donkey. He rode into the city on it, as a humble King.
The people spread their cloaks and palm branches on the road. They shouted, "Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!"
On Palm Sunday at Mass, we hold palm branches and remember how the crowds welcomed Jesus. Holy Week begins.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: On Palm Sunday, we celebrate Jesus as our King. Holy Week begins, and we get ready for Easter.

pages.text: After supper, Jesus went with His friends to a garden to pray. He said, "Stay here and keep watch with me." Then He went a little farther and prayed alone.
Jesus was sad and troubled. He prayed, "Father, if it is possible, take this away. But let your will be done." Jesus trusted His Father, even when it was hard.
When Jesus came back, His friends were asleep. Soon soldiers came to take Jesus away. His friends were afraid and ran off, but Jesus went peacefully.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus prayed to His Father when things were hard. We can pray to God when we are sad or scared.

stories.title: Peter Says He Does Not Know Jesus

pages.text: At the Last Supper, Peter said, "Lord, I will never leave you!" Jesus said, "Before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you do not know me." Peter said, "No!"
Later, soldiers took Jesus away. Peter followed and waited in a courtyard. People said, "You were with Jesus!" Peter was afraid.
Three times Peter said, "I do not know Him!" Then a rooster crowed. Jesus turned and looked at Peter, and Peter remembered. He went away and cried.
Peter was very sorry. After Jesus rose from the dead, He forgave Peter and loved him still. Jesus always forgives us when we are sorry.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Peter was afraid and did wrong, but Jesus forgave him. When we do wrong, we can say sorry, and Jesus forgives us.

pages.text: Jesus had done nothing wrong, but some leaders were jealous of Him. Pilate, the governor, let soldiers take Jesus away to be crucified.
Jesus carried His heavy cross through the streets. His mother Mary and many women who loved Him followed. A man named Simon helped Him carry it.
On a hill called Calvary, Jesus was put on the cross. He prayed, "Father, forgive them." Mary and John stayed close to Him.
Jesus gave up His life out of love for us. The sky grew dark. Jesus died, and His friends were very sad.
Joseph of Arimathea gently laid Jesus' body in a new tomb, and a big stone was rolled in front. Jesus died to save us from our sins. We remember this on Good Friday.

thinkAboutIt.title: Think about it
thinkAboutIt.text: Jesus gave His life out of love, to save us from sin. On Good Friday, we remember how much He loves us.
